name: ashui
description: Native reactive UI for Haxe, with typed HXX, CSS, themes and animation.
releasenote: Native CSS engine: matching, cascade, media and queries run in blinc_abi, restyling only what a change reaches; CSS compiled at build time with imports and the blinc-css compiler bundled; borders take layout space; inset, zero-blur and notched shadows drawn as CSS does.
